findings.problem: In Switzerland people commonly say merci (merci vielmal) for thank you, so regional should not be null.
findings.fix: regional: { where: "Switzerland", text: "Merci (Merci vielmal for thanks a lot) is very common in everyday Swiss German, alongside danke." }

findings.problem: The example uses words not met before this card: für, deine, Hilfe. In the starter path it may use only earlier cards' words, its own, names, numbers and at most one obvious cognate.

note: Dankeschön and vielen Dank also mean thank you, but danke is clearly the basic expected answer, so no hint is needed.
